title: salix × rubens var. viridis
intro: Salix × rubens var. viridis, commonly known as the weeping willow or green osier, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Salicaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Salix × rubens var. viridis include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated tissues, reduce inflammation and swelling, and facilitate the expulsion of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
